items.title: 12.9 Sulfur ki oxidation states ki stability (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.9 with Figure 12.9, printed pages 281-282.

blocks.text: Sulfur ki oxidation states ki stability Frost diagram se samjhai jati hai, redox couple X(n)/X(0) ke liye oxidation state n ke muqable nE standard ka plot (Figure 12.9). Yeh do intehai pH qeematon, pH 0 aur pH 14 (tezabi aur basic halaat), par oxidation states ki nisbati stability dikhata hai. Ise oxidation state ke muqable standard reaction Gibbs free energy ka plot bhi samjha ja sakta hai, kyunke -delta G standard = nFE standard, ya -delta G standard / F = nE standard, jahan E standard standard reduction potential, F Faraday constant aur n muntaqil electrons ki tadaad hai. Zyada mustahkam oxidation state ki nE qeemat kam (Gibbs energy zyada manfi) hoti hai, to woh diagram mein sab se neeche hoti hai; zyada musbat dhalan (slope) wala couple achha oxidising agent aur zyada manfi dhalan wala achha reducing agent hai.

Sulfur ke diagram mein +6 (sulfate) thermodynamic taur par sab se mustahkam oxidation state hai, intehai basic halaat mein bilkul ghair-oxidising, jabke intehai tezabi halaat mein bohat ghair-mustahkam. Basic mahol mein sab oxidised sulfur states element se zyada mustahkam hain, magar tezabi halaat mein sab oxidised states element se kam mustahkam.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: Table 12.4 ke data ke saath aath-rukni sulfur halqa. Oopar darmiyan: unpaired electrons aur misalon ke saath oxidation states ki table. Oopar daen: schematic Frost diagram jis mein element sulfur se surkh tezabi curve charhta aur neela basic curve girta hai. Darmiyan: parhne ke usool aur sulfur ke reactions. Neeche: rubber zanjeeron ke darmiyan sulfur cross-links ka khaka fertiliser, gunpowder aur organic istemalat ke saath.
blocks.caption: S8 taaj, sulfur ki oxidation states, schematic Frost diagram, sulfur ke reactions aur istemalat (Figures 12.7 se 12.10 aur Table 12.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; Frost curves schematic).
blocks.long_description: Sulfur apne saath single bonds se taaj jaise aath-rukni halqon mein jurti hai, is liye woh kam reactivity wala peela solid hai. Electrons ko apne khali d orbitals mein promote karna use sulfur dioxide mein +4 aur sulfur trioxide aur sulfate mein +6 tak pohnchne deta hai. Frost diagram par sab se neecha nuqta sab se mustahkam state hai: alkaline solution mein sulfate element se bohat neeche aur be-zarar hai, magar acid mein oxidised states element sulfur se oopar aur oxidising hain. Garam sulfur jal kar sulfur dioxide deti hai, nitric acid se sulfuric acid mein oxidise hoti hai, silver aur copper ko sulfides ke taur par dhundla karti hai, cyanide ko thiocyanate mein badalti hai aur fluorine se mil kar inert gas SF6 banati hai. Us ke istemalat rubber ki vulcanisation se fertilisers aur gunpowder se ho kar sulfa drugs, sulfur dyes aur fragrances tak hain.

blocks.prompt: pH 0 aur pH 14 par pani mein sulfur ki kaun si oxidation states sab se mustahkam hain, aur apne parosiyon ko milane wali lakeer se oopar parne wali species ka kya matlab hai (exercise Q.2h; MCQ VII, X)?
blocks.explanation: pH 14 par sab se neecha nuqta sulfate, +6, sab se mustahkam state hai. pH 0 par sab oxidised states element sulfur se oopar hain, to acid mein element (oxidation state 0) sab se mustahkam species hai. Parosiyon ko milane wali lakeer se oopar wali species un ke lihaz se ghair-mustahkam hai aur disproportionation ki taraf mail hai.

items: Frost diagram: pH 0 aur 14 par oxidation state ke muqable nE standard (= -delta G / F); sab se neecha nuqta sab se mustahkam; musbat dhalan oxidising, manfi reducing.
Sulfur: +6 (sulfate) base mein sab se mustahkam aur ghair-oxidising; acid mein oxidised states element sulfur se oopar (kam mustahkam), base mein us se neeche.
